failure.exception: ValueError: MCL finalized source is stale
failure.natural_recovery: the first completed reopen minute existed and the unchanged worker succeeded

root_cause.timer_law: Sunday through Thursday resumes at exactly 18:00 ET after excluding the 17:00-18:00 ET maintenance hour
root_cause.profitability_law: 18:00 ET is the first required market-open evaluation minute
root_cause.source_law: refresh_mcl_source_if_due requires the current minute while mcl_source_snapshot also rejects the pre-maintenance finalized minute after eight minutes
root_cause.causal_impossibility: at 18:00:10 ET no completed 18:00-18:01 reopen minute can yet exist
root_cause.call_order: broker snapshot -> finalized-source refresh -> quote -> order/position reconciliation -> risk -> plan -> checkpoint
root_cause.consequence: the impossible source refresh aborts all downstream reconciliation and creates a required evidence gap

existing_safety.risk_reduction_precedence: an existing position with a safety breach or exit trigger is flattened before entry logic

gold_precedent.architecture: the source checkpoint is supplied independently to the live runtime after broker and quote acquisition
gold_precedent.law: old source blocks a fresh entry while broker, quote, position, pending-order, risk, exit, and flatten ownership remain observable
gold_precedent.reuse_boundary: semantic precedent only; no Gold source, timer, strategy, selection, or live authority should change

recommended_resolution.name: Causal Maintenance-Reopen Reconciliation
recommended_resolution.law: at exactly Sunday-through-Thursday 18:00 ET, if the due finalized reopen minute does not yet exist and one identity-valid prior selected source checkpoint exists, reuse that checkpoint for broker/quote/order/position/risk reconciliation only
recommended_resolution.entry_law: retain the existing 120-second admission-age check, so no pre-maintenance target can enter
recommended_resolution.next_minute_law: at 18:01 ET require the newly completed reopen minute and resume the unchanged strict refresh path
recommended_resolution.evidence_law: mark the plan/checkpoint as reopen reconciliation; never disguise general feed staleness or backfill the existing gap
recommended_resolution.selection_law: after proof, use the existing two-sided nontransmitting LIMIT commissioning path to create a fresh flat Stage-112 selection and evidence clock

rejected_alternatives.name: exclude the 18:00 ET slot
rejected_alternatives.reason: would remove the first reopen reconciliation minute from profitability evidence and weaken safety observability

rejected_alternatives.name: allow stale source whenever refresh fails
rejected_alternatives.reason: would conceal ordinary feed outages and is broader than the proven causal impossibility

rejected_alternatives.name: backfill or rebase the existing prefix
rejected_alternatives.reason: would rewrite missing evidence instead of preserving the quarantined run

rejected_alternatives.name: change the shared futures reducer
rejected_alternatives.reason: the reducer correctly detected the gap; the defect is upstream MCL runtime coverage
